seo.title: AI chatbot for financial services enquiries | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer product and process questions, capture enquiries and book calls, with guardrails against financial advice.

hero.title: Answer enquiries without giving advice.
hero.body: Explain your products and processes, capture enquiries and book calls with your advisers. Guardrails keep the agent from giving financial advice.
hero.reassurance: Product information only. Enquiries saved. Advisers for anything personal.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Set the guardrail “never give financial advice” on your agent’s persona.
Check your regulator’s rules before collecting financial details in chat.

items.q: Will the agent give financial advice?
items.a: Not if you set the guardrail. Advice questions can be passed to your advisers.

problems.title: Where enquiries stall, and what your agent does about it.
problems.intro: People want to know the process before they talk to anyone. Your agent explains it without giving advice.

items.pain: The same process questions, every day.
items.scene: Documents, timelines, eligibility. Your advisers answer them between meetings.
items.fix: Your agent explains eligibility, documents and timelines from your own information.
items.reply: You need PAN, Aadhaar and your last three payslips.

items.scene: A name, no phone, no product of interest.
items.fix: Your agent collects contact details and the product they are interested in.
items.ask: I am interested in a home loan.
items.reply: Happy to help. May I have your name and phone?

items.scene: Someone asks what they should invest in. That is advice.
items.fix: Anything that needs advice goes to your team. Your agent never gives financial advice.
items.reply: An adviser will help you with that. Shall I book a call?
